reason: The short-circuit was removed (GroupsResource.java:113, GroupResource.java:179), but canView(g) still covers the realm-wide case: V1 GroupPermissions.java:255 starts with `canView() || canManage()`, and V2 GroupPermissionsV2.java:141-150 falls back to the all-groups type resource when the group has no resource of its own. The patch's own testViewGroups expects topGroup (no per-group grant) to be listed under an all-groups VIEW permission, so listings are not empty.
